verdict.rationale: Cerebras explicitly supports vision-capable models with image inputs (base64 data URI, OpenAI-compatible image_url) per docs-15 and docs-27, but there is no evidence of audio models (speech-to-text/text-to-speech) or image-generation models on the platform — the models list is described purely in terms of open-source LLM alternatives for Claude/GPT/Gemini (docs-18), suggesting a text/vision-focused chat completion API rather than a full multimodal suite. Missing for 10: audio model support, image-generation model support, and any documented roadmap or availability for these modalities.
